events.why: Deliberate near-miss: the same domain vocabulary (fine, cleanup plan, groundwater, reconsideration window) but a different authority, respondent, instrument, site and magnitude. Not the same matter. A purely lexical embedding cannot tell the two Spanish gazette records apart (they share the function-word mass of legal Spanish) — that is the failure mode this packet exists to expose, and the fake-embedder baseline below records it.

rubric.requirement: Report exactly one material decision for the window: ARAV Resolution 117-2026, first published 2026-11-16 in gazette edition 4127.
The five derivative documents are coverage of that one decision: one story, not six.
AREV Resolution 098-2026 is a separate matter and must not be merged into the ARAV decision or reported as part of it.
English coverage must resolve back to the Spanish original notice (the gazette record), not stand as an independent decision.

fake_embedder_baseline.note: Deterministic baseline of gaceta's FakeEmbedder (signed bag-of-words) at the fixture threshold 0.70, window 21 days, measured on this exact packet. Same-language coverage of the decision joins into one story per language; the English coverage of the unrelated event stays out of every story; and the lookalike Spanish gazette record of the unrelated event MERGES into the decision's Spanish story — a purely lexical embedding cannot separate two same-register legal texts. That merge is the failure mode the packet is built to expose: score a run of `gaceta eval` against golden.json and the pairwise/B-cubed numbers fall out of exactly this partition. This is plumbing, not a quality claim: the packet asserts nothing about any live model.

expected_metrics.note: gaceta.evals.clustering.evaluate() of that partition against golden.json — the numbers a FakeEmbedder run of `gaceta eval` must reproduce exactly.
